analytic_mode_convention: FFT of conjugated h_22 complex mode; compare positive-frequency bins, optimize one global time and phase shift, no amplitude or intrinsic-parameter fit.
limitations: Five published-paper cases, some potentially used in original v4 calibration, and a complex dominant-mode proxy; finite mass and FFT grid, no full-domain bound, no independent ROM.
lower_cutoff: max(10 Hz, 2*NR catalog reference orbital M Omega/(2*pi*M_seconds)); reference time equals the highest-resolution metadata relaxation time
psd: Pinned public lalsimulation SimNoisePSDaLIGOZeroDetHighPower; validation-only dependency
purpose: Prospectively frozen detector-weighted h22 comparison for five original-paper NR catalog cases, before reading selected waveforms or model residuals. Same selected-case 0.99 proxy as prior SXS diagnostics; this is a regression check, not independent release validation or ROM qualification.
time_taper: At both common settled-support boundaries multiply by 0.5*(1+tanh((t-t0-w/2)/(w/10))) and its time-reversed end factor.
